import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXM = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] mp = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] demand = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, limit, sx, sy, S, T, total;
    static int[][] id = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] que = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] level = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+5];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+5];
    static int ecnt = 0;
    static int[] to = new int[2*MAXM+5];
    static int[] nxt = new int[2*MAXM+5];
    static int[] cap = new int[2*MAXM+5];
    static int[][] distCell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static Point[] qp = new Point[MAXM];

    static class Point {
        int x, y;
        Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || used[x][y] || mp[x][y] < '0' || mp[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        to[ecnt] = v; cap[ecnt] = c; nxt[ecnt] = head[u]; head[u] = ecnt++;
        to[ecnt] = u; cap[ecnt] = 0; nxt[ecnt] = head[v]; head[v] = ecnt++;
    }

    static void bfsZ() {
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) distZ[i][j] = INF;
        distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        qp[r++] = new Point(sx, sy);
        used[sx][sy] = true;
        while (l < r) {
            Point p = qp[l++];
            int ax = p.x, ay = p.y;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny)) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[ax][ay] + 1;
                    used[nx][ny] = true;
                    qp[r++] = new Point(nx, ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void findLinks(int tx, int ty, int node) {
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) { used[i][j] = false; distCell[i][j] = INF; }
        used[tx][ty] = true;
        distCell[tx][ty] = 0;
        qp[r++] = new Point(tx, ty);
        while (l < r) {
            Point p = qp[l++];
            int ax = p.x, ay = p.y;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny)) {
                    distCell[nx][ny] = distCell[ax][ay] + 1;
                    used[nx][ny] = true;
                    if (distCell[nx][ny] < distZ[nx][ny]) {
                        qp[r++] = new Point(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distCell[i][j] <= limit && demand[i][j] > '0' && demand[i][j] <= '9' && distCell[i][j] <= distZ[i][j]) {
                    addEdge(node, id[i][j] + total, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) level[i] = -1;
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        level[S] = 0;
        que[r++] = S;
        while (l < r) {
            int u = que[l++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                if (cap[i] > 0 && level[v] == -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    que[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[T] != -1;
    }

    static int send(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        int got = 0;
        for (int i = head[u]; i != -1 && flow > 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int v = to[i];
            if (cap[i] > 0 && level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
                int ret = send(v, Math.min(cap[i], flow));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    cap[i] -= ret;
                    cap[i ^ 1] += ret;
                    flow -= ret;
                    got += ret;
                }
            }
        }
        if (got == 0) level[u] = INF;
        return got;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            int f;
            while ((f = send(S, INF)) > 0) ans += f;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) mp[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) demand[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }

        // find zombie start
        sx = -1; sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && sx == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) id[i][j] = ++total;

        S = 2 * total + 1;
        T = S + 1;

        // initialize head array
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) head[i] = -1;

        bfsZ();

        // reset used for later BFS
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) used[i][j] = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mp[i][j] > '0' && mp[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, id[i][j], mp[i][j] - '0');
                    findLinks(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (demand[i][j] > '0' && demand[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id[i][j] + total, T, demand[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
